Each alias is scoped to a distinct test suite testing different subsystems (playcut metadata caching vs. Discogs entity resolver caching); consolidating them into a shared alias would introduce an artificial coupling between two independent test files. The structural coincidence (shared_field_count=2, differing_slots=null) reflects that both are thin type-alias wrappers over the same underlying mock session type, not a meaningful duplication that warrants extraction.
